description: Bike Parking is a dataset listed in Transport for NSW Open Data Hub (opendata.transport.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport Open Data Hub. Bike sheds and lockers' locations, including latitude and longitude, quantity and asset IDs. Bike sheds and lockers help to keep your bicycle, helmet and associated equipment safe and protected from the weather. Bike sheds are enclosed shared shelters where you can store your bicycle out of the weather, free of charge. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Transport Open Data Hub. Its tags are bicycle, bike, bike lockers, bike parking, geospatial. It offers 8 resource(s) in csv, geojson, json, kml, map. The portal shows 2026-08-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tfnsw-open-data-hub.
